Name: Dual winter respiratory wave (tripledemic)
Marker rule: two or more pathogens above P90 of NHSN admissions or NSSP ED share

Name: Off season COVID resurgence
Marker rule: Summer or early autumn COVID exceedance in NREVSS positivity, NSSP ED share, or NWSS wastewater

Name: Acute outbreak velocity
Marker rule: weekly median Rt above 1 for three or more consecutive weeks, any pathogen

Name: Pediatric surge, RSV led
Marker rule: RSV above P90 in NSSP ED share or NREVSS positivity

Name: Geriatric severe season
Marker rule: RESP-NET combined 65+ weekly rate above P90

Name: Invasive meningococcal activity surge
Marker rule: NNDSS weekly meningococcal cases above P90

Name: Immune evasion or vaccine mismatch
Episodes: 2021-12..2022-02 (Omicron immune escape; Historical Outbreaks & Surges catalog row)
Marker rule: Event catalog admission: documented episode of vaccine effectiveness failure or immune escape

Name: Antimicrobial resistance advisory
Episodes: 2020 (beta lactamase producing serogroup Y, ciprofloxacin resistant cluster); 2024-02 (MMWR prophylaxis change for ciprofloxacin resistance areas)
Marker rule: Event catalog admission: federal advisory on resistant strains of a target pathogen

Name: Economic and cost burden lens
Marker rule: None: no observable weekly marker exists, so no frequency is countable
